name: TickTick
description: Show a TickTick list or project with empty checkboxes. Place multiple instances for different lists.
author: You

secrets.label: TickTick API Token
secrets.description: From TickTick web: Avatar → Settings → Account → API Token

titleFontSize.title: Title font size (px, 0 = relative)
titleFontSize.description: Fixed pixel size for the title. 0 keeps it relative to the Style font size. Content always follows Style > Font Size.

projectId.title: Project ID
projectId.description: Paste the project ID (from the URL or API). Use "All" with care.

projectIds.title: Project IDs (comma-separated)
projectIds.description: For timeline multi-list. Leave empty to use single Project ID.

projectColors.title: Project colors (comma-separated hex)
projectColors.description: Optional. One color per project ID, e.g. #60a5fa,#f59e0b,#ef4444

tagFilter.title: Tag filter
tagFilter.description: Comma-separated. OR by default. Use + or & for AND, - or ! for NOT. Example: work, urgent+today, -done

hideOverdue.title: Hide overdue (list view)
hideOverdue.description: Hide tasks whose due date is in the past, whether completed or not

greyOutOverdueAgenda.title: Grey out overdue (agenda view)
greyOutOverdueAgenda.description: In agenda view, grey out tasks past their due date. Completed tasks still disappear.

showQrCode.title: Show QR code
showQrCode.description: Show a QR that opens the list in TickTick (single project) or a search (tag filter). Not available for multi-list timelines.

hourLabelFontSize.title: Hour label font size (px)
hourLabelFontSize.description: Fixed pixel size for timeline hour labels. Independent of Style > Font Size.

currentTimeBadgeFontSize.title: Current-time badge font size (px)
currentTimeBadgeFontSize.description: Fixed pixel size for the red current-time badge. Independent of Style > Font Size.

timelineGutterWidth.title: Timeline gutter width (px, 0 = auto)
timelineGutterWidth.description: Width of the left time column. 0 keeps the automatic size that scales with Style font size. Positive value sets a fixed pixel width.
